segments.speaker: Amos
segments.text: Hear ye this word which I take up against you, even a lamentation, O house of Israel.
The virgin of Israel is fallen; she shall no more rise: she is forsaken upon her land; there is none to raise her up.
For thus saith the Lord GOD;

segments.speaker: the Lord God
segments.text: The city that went out by a thousand shall leave an hundred, and that which went forth by an hundred shall leave ten, to the house of Israel.
¶ For thus saith the LORD unto the house of Israel,

segments.speaker: the Lord
segments.text: Seek ye me, and ye shall live:

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: But seek not Beth-el, nor enter into Gilgal, and pass not to Beer-sheba: for Gilgal shall surely go into captivity, and Beth-el shall come to nought.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Seek the LORD, and ye shall live; lest he break out like fire in the house of Joseph, and devour it, and there be none to quench it in Beth-el.
Ye who turn judgment to wormwood, and leave off righteousness in the earth,

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Seek him that maketh the seven stars and Orion, and turneth the shadow of death into the morning, and maketh the day dark with night: that calleth for the waters of the sea, and poureth them out upon the face of the earth: The LORD is his name:
That strengtheneth the spoiled against the strong, so that the spoiled shall come against the fortress.
They hate him that rebuketh in the gate, and they abhor him that speaketh uprightly.

segments.speaker: Amos
segments.text: Forasmuch therefore as your treading is upon the poor, and ye take from him burdens of wheat: ye have built houses of hewn stone, but ye shall not dwell in them; ye have planted pleasant vineyards, but ye shall not drink wine of them.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: For I know your manifold transgressions and your mighty sins: they afflict the just, they take a bribe, and they turn aside the poor in the gate from their right.
Therefore the prudent shall keep silence in that time; for it is an evil time.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Seek good, and not evil, that ye may live: and so the LORD, the God of hosts, shall be with you, as ye have spoken.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Hate the evil, and love the good, and establish judgment in the gate: it may be that the LORD God of hosts will be gracious unto the remnant of Joseph.
Therefore the LORD, the God of hosts, the Lord, saith thus;

segments.speaker: the Lord
segments.text: Wailing shall be in all streets; and they shall say in all the highways, Alas! alas! and they shall call the husbandman to mourning, and such as are skilful of lamentation to wailing.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: And in all vineyards shall be wailing: for I will pass through thee,
saith the LORD.

segments.speaker: Amos
segments.text: Woe unto you that desire the day of the LORD! to what end is it for you? the day of the LORD is darkness, and not light.
As if a man did flee from a lion, and a bear met him; or went into the house, and leaned his hand on the wall, and a serpent bit him.

segments.speaker: Amos
segments.text: Shall not the day of the LORD be darkness, and not light? even very dark, and no brightness in it?

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: ¶ I hate, I despise your feast days, and I will not smell in your solemn assemblies.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Though ye offer me burnt offerings and your meat offerings, I will not accept them: neither will I regard the peace offerings of your fat beasts.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Take thou away from me the noise of thy songs; for I will not hear the melody of thy viols.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: But let judgment run down as waters, and righteousness as a mighty stream.

segments.speaker: Amos
segments.text: Have ye offered unto me sacrifices and offerings in the wilderness forty years, O house of Israel?
But ye have borne the tabernacle of your Moloch and Chiun your images, the star of your god, which ye made to yourselves.

footnotes: the tabernacle…: or, Siccuth your king

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Therefore will I cause you to go into captivity beyond Damascus,
saith the LORD, whose name is The God of hosts.
